question: Are the existing macrophage-panel disease differences and within-disease FABP4-versus-matrix panel associations dependent on a single component or donor?
decision: Bound the fragility of fixed exposed RNA summaries while retaining original full panels, donors and results; neither replace a panel nor exclude an influential donor.
strongest_rival: A single panel component or influential donor dominates the descriptive association; cohort annotation and source imbalance remain alternative explanations beyond these diagnostics.
discriminator: Every single-component omission (renormalized mean of three remaining genes) and every single-donor omission, separately rather than factorially, compared with frozen full-data estimates; exact original floors and site restrictions retained.
exposure_record: All original human gene/panel/disease/annotation/depth results, E1-E6 and follow-up feasibility are exposed. Primary component table is already exposed. External component values are newly reaggregated under the original qualified raw-count rules and exact donor/site selections. No confirmation, panel reselection or donor exclusion.
biological_unit: Human donor: GSE136831 donor and GSE135893 Sample_Name, with nested libraries and cells. Repeated omissions are deterministic diagnostics, not independent samples.
nesting_and_overlap: Both prior cohorts are reused. Primary panel-selection atlas is the same GSE136831 cohort. External study independence is published cohort evidence, not a patient-identity audit. LOCO and LODO rows reuse nearly all donors/components.
population_and_selection: Primary deposited Macrophage floor20 plus existing AllMacrophages floor50 comparator, Control/IPF/COPD. External original macrophage union and Macrophages-only, floor50, all_sources and Vanderbilt scopes, exact frozen donor/source sets. No new annotation or floor sweep; no proxy/recipient analysis.
contrast: Unweighted donor panel mean differences: primary IPF-Control, COPD-Control, IPF-COPD; external IPF-Control. Within-disease FABP4-panel versus matrix-associated macrophage-panel Spearman correlation. For coupling omit one component from one panel while the other remains full.
endpoint: Full point estimates and copied original pointwise bootstrap intervals; all one-component and one-donor point estimates, changes from full, ranges and strict sign reversals. Omission ranges are not confidence intervals.
methods: Primary existing per-gene log2(1+all-gene pseudobulk CPM); external sum qualified cached raw counts across original macrophage subtypes before transformation, use all-gene denominator and audit against independently reaggregated selected counts. Full panels must reproduce frozen scores, estimates and n. LOCO uses mean of three remaining components; LODO uses original full panels after omitting each donor involved in that contrast/association. Correlation requires >=8 varying donors, contrast >=3 per group; omission failures remain rows. No new bootstrap, clinical, depth, floor or single-gene contrast fits. Independently verify all means using math.fsum and correlations using scalar tie ranks/Pearson. No combination of donor and component omission.
missingness_and_exclusions: No outcome-based selection, missing-as-zero, donor removal from the primary result or reduced-panel replacement. External SELENOP remains unmapped and unused; identity/proxy hold retained. External Vanderbilt7/6 within-group correlations and recipient7/3 remain held. Keep nonestimable omissions and unchanged source imbalance. Required retained component values must be finite; no skip-missing mean. Comparison-to-reference fields are unavailable when the full reference is undefined, while omission/estimability counts and held rows remain.
multiplicity: All omissions and fixed scopes reported as descriptive sensitivity; no p-values, selection of favorable omission, new discovery or multiplicity-controlled claims.
precision_basis: Original full-data pointwise bootstrap intervals copied with provenance. New omission ranges quantify observed influence only, without sampling-uncertainty or precision/power guarantees.
interpretation_limit: Exposed RNA-summary robustness in reused observational cohorts. Stability does not establish biological transport, secretion, matrix production, macrophage-fibroblast signaling, repair or original infection-context mediation.
stop_rule: Stop on qualified raw/component parity, source/donor selection, full-score/estimate/n or scalar verification disagreement. Retain failed thresholds and all omissions; no panel/donor/threshold tuning.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized F2 adds panel/donor fragility diagnostics while preserving original human outputs and selection rules.
